answer: Every epoch the network seeds five canary identities that copy the exact fingerprint of known sybil bots. Step one: graders who flag a canary collect a 0.2 POA bounty. Step two: any grader who passes one forfeits their 50 POA stake bond. Step three: to ride out a single seeded wave a farm must corrupt 90% of the grading panel, which means bonding roughly $12,000 across colluding graders plus 60 hours of retraining bots to dodge new canaries each dawn. Push a forged peer onto the ledge and the bond is gone. Ferrous rails: cheap to lay, brutally expensive to derail.
